local function variable(name)
    return {kind = "variable", name = name}
end
local function abstraction(name, body)
    return {kind = "abstraction", name = name, left = body}
end
local function application(func, argument)
    return {kind = "application", left = func, right = argument}
end
local function free_variables(term)
    if term.free then
        return term.free
    end
    local result = {}
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        result[term.name] = true
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
        for name in pairs(free_variables(term.left)) do
            if name ~= term.name then
                result[name] = true
            end
        end
    elseif term.kind == "application" then
        for name in pairs(free_variables(term.left)) do
            result[name] = true
        end
        for name in pairs(free_variables(term.right)) do
            result[name] = true
        end
    end
    term.free = result
    return result
end
local function ordered_names(set)
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(set) do
        names[#names + 1] = name
    end
    table.sort(names)
    return names
end
local function print_term(term, at_end, debruijn)
    if term.kind == "variable" or term.kind == "macro" or term.kind == "constant" then
        return term.name
    elseif term.kind == "index" then
        return tostring(term.value)
    elseif term.kind == "numeral" then
        return "#" .. term.value
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
        local names, body = {}, term
        while body.kind == "abstraction" do
            names[#names + 1] = body.name
            body = body.left
        end
        local text
        if debruijn then
            text = string.rep("\\", #names) .. print_term(body, true, true)
        else
            text = "\\" .. table.concat(names, " ") .. ". " .. print_term(body, true, false)
        end
        return at_end and text or "(" .. text .. ")"
    end
    local left = print_term(term.left, false, debruijn)
    local right =
        term.right.kind == "application" and "(" .. print_term(term.right, true, debruijn) .. ")" or
        print_term(term.right, at_end, debruijn)
    return left .. " " .. right
end
local function substitute(term, name, replacement)
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return term.name == name and replacement or term
    end
    if term.kind == "application" then
        return application(
            substitute(term.left, name, replacement),
            substitute(term.right, name, replacement)
        )
    end
    if term.kind ~= "abstraction" or term.name == name or not free_variables(term.left)[name] then
        return term
    end
    local binder, body = term.name, term.left
    if free_variables(replacement)[binder] then
        local base, index = binder:gsub("%d+$", ""), 1
        while free_variables(replacement)[base .. index] or free_variables(body)[base .. index] do
            index = index + 1
        end
        binder = base .. index
        body = substitute(body, term.name, variable(binder))
    end
    return abstraction(binder, substitute(body, name, replacement))
end
local function name_sequence(index)
    return string.char(97 + index % 26) .. (index >= 26 and tostring(index // 26) or "")
end
local function canonical(term)
    local free, counter, bound = free_variables(term), 0, {}
    local function visit(term)
        if term.kind == "variable" then
            local stack = bound[term.name]
            return stack and #stack > 0 and variable(stack[#stack]) or term
        elseif term.kind == "application" then
            return application(visit(term.left), visit(term.right))
        end
        local name
        repeat
            name = name_sequence(counter)
            counter = counter + 1
        until not free[name]
        bound[term.name] = bound[term.name] or {}
        local stack = bound[term.name]
        stack[#stack + 1] = name
        local body = visit(term.left)
        stack[#stack] = nil
        return abstraction(name, body)
    end
    return visit(term)
end
local function de_bruijn(term, bound)
    bound = bound or {}
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        for i = #bound, 1, -1 do
            if bound[i] == term.name then
                return {kind = "index", value = #bound - i}
            end
        end
        return term
    elseif term.kind == "application" then
        return application(de_bruijn(term.left, bound), de_bruijn(term.right, bound))
    end
    bound[#bound + 1] = term.name
    local body = de_bruijn(term.left, bound)
    bound[#bound] = nil
    return abstraction("", body)
end
local function from_de_bruijn(term)
    local counter, free, bound = 0, free_variables(term), {}
    local function visit(term)
        if term.kind == "variable" then
            return term
        end
        if term.kind == "index" then
            return variable(bound[#bound - term.value])
        end
        if term.kind == "application" then
            return application(visit(term.left), visit(term.right))
        end
        local name
        repeat
            name = name_sequence(counter)
            counter = counter + 1
        until not free[name]
        bound[#bound + 1] = name
        local body = visit(term.left)
        bound[#bound] = nil
        return abstraction(name, body)
    end
    return visit(term)
end
local function equivalent(a, b)
    return print_term(de_bruijn(a), true, true) == print_term(de_bruijn(b), true, true)
end
local function fail(format, ...)
    error({reason = string.format(format, ...)}, 0)
end
local function has(items, value)
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == value then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function lower(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "a" and c <= "z"
end
local function upper(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "A" and c <= "Z"
end
local function digit(c)
    return c ~= "" and c >= "0" and c <= "9"
end
local function lex(line, text, offset)
    local tokens, i = {}, 1
    while i <= #text do
        local c = text:sub(i, i)
        if c == " " then
            i = i + 1
        else
            local start, kind = i, nil
            if ("\\.()=;"):find(c, 1, true) then
                kind = c
                i = i + 1
            elseif lower(c) then
                kind = "variable"
                repeat
                    i = i + 1
                    c = text:sub(i, i)
                until not lower(c) and not digit(c)
            elseif upper(c) then
                kind = "macro"
                repeat
                    i = i + 1
                    c = text:sub(i, i)
                until not upper(c) and not digit(c) and c ~= "_"
            elseif c == "#" and digit(text:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) then
                kind = "numeral"
                i = i + 1
                repeat
                    i = i + 1
                until not digit(text:sub(i, i))
            else
                fail("column %d: unexpected character '%s'", offset + i, c)
            end
            local token = {kind = kind, text = text:sub(start, i - 1), column = offset + start}
            if kind == "numeral" then
                token.value = tonumber(token.text:sub(2))
            end
            tokens[#tokens + 1] = token
        end
    end
    tokens[#tokens + 1] = {kind = "end", column = #line + 1}
    return tokens
end
local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser
function Parser:peek()
    return self.tokens[self.at]
end
function Parser:expect(kind)
    local token = self:peek()
    if token.kind ~= kind then
        local notation =
            kind == "variable" and "variable" or kind == "macro" and "macro name" or
            "'" .. kind .. "'"
        fail("column %d: expected %s", token.column, notation)
    end
    self.at = self.at + 1
    return token
end
function Parser:term()
    local elements = {}
    while true do
        local token = self:peek()
        if
            token.kind ~= "variable" and token.kind ~= "macro" and token.kind ~= "numeral" and
                token.kind ~= "("
         then
            break
        end
        self.at = self.at + 1
        if token.kind == "(" then
            local value = self:term()
            self:expect(")")
            elements[#elements + 1] = value
        else
            elements[#elements + 1] = {kind = token.kind, name = token.text, value = token.value}
        end
    end
    if self:peek().kind == "\\" then
        self.at = self.at + 1
        local names = {self:expect("variable").text}
        while self:peek().kind == "variable" do
            names[#names + 1] = self:expect("variable").text
        end
        self:expect(".")
        local value = self:term()
        for i = #names, 1, -1 do
            value = abstraction(names[i], value)
        end
        elements[#elements + 1] = value
    end
    if #elements == 0 then
        fail("column %d: expected term", self:peek().column)
    end
    local result = elements[1]
    for i = 2, #elements do
        result = application(result, elements[i])
    end
    return result
end
function Parser:finish()
    local token = self:peek()
    if token.kind ~= "end" then
        fail("column %d: unexpected '%s'", token.column, token.text)
    end
end
local function references(term, result)
    result = result or {}
    if term.kind == "macro" then
        result[#result + 1] = term.name
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
        references(term.left, result)
    elseif term.kind == "application" then
        references(term.left, result)
        references(term.right, result)
    end
    return result
end
local reserved = {"S", "K", "I", "NORMAL", "APPLICATIVE", "CBN", "CBV"}
local Workbench = {}
Workbench.__index = Workbench
function Workbench.new()
    local body =
        application(
        application(variable("x"), variable("z")),
        application(variable("y"), variable("z"))
    )
    return setmetatable(
        {
            macros = {
                I = abstraction("x", variable("x")),
                K = abstraction("x", abstraction("y", variable("x"))),
                S = abstraction("x", abstraction("y", abstraction("z", body)))
            },
            steps = false,
            eta = false,
            limit = 10000
        },
        Workbench
    )
end
function Workbench:emit(format, ...)
    io.write(string.format(format, ...), "\n")
end
function Workbench:expand(term)
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return term
    end
    if term.kind == "macro" then
        local value = self.macros[term.name]
        if not value then
            fail("unbound macro %s", term.name)
        end
        return self:expand(value)
    end
    if term.kind == "numeral" then
        local body = variable("x")
        for _ = 1, term.value do
            body = application(variable("f"), body)
        end
        return abstraction("f", abstraction("x", body))
    end
    if term.kind == "abstraction" then
        return abstraction(term.name, self:expand(term.left))
    end
    return application(self:expand(term.left), self:expand(term.right))
end
function Workbench:depends(name, target, seen)
    if name == target then
        return true
    end
    if seen[name] or name == "S" or name == "K" or name == "I" or not self.macros[name] then
        return false
    end
    seen[name] = true
    for _, reference in ipairs(references(self.macros[name])) do
        if self:depends(reference, target, seen) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function eta_redex(term)
    return term.kind == "abstraction" and term.left.kind == "application" and
        term.left.right.kind == "variable" and
        term.left.right.name == term.name and
        not free_variables(term.left.left)[term.name]
end
local function one_step(term, strategy, eta)
    if term.kind == "application" then
        if (strategy == "NORMAL" or strategy == "CBN") and term.left.kind == "abstraction" then
            return substitute(term.left.left, term.left.name, term.right), "beta"
        end
        local value, kind = one_step(term.left, strategy, eta)
        if value then
            return application(value, term.right), kind
        end
        if strategy == "CBN" then
            return
        end
        value, kind = one_step(term.right, strategy, eta)
        if value then
            return application(term.left, value), kind
        end
        if
            term.left.kind == "abstraction" and
                (strategy ~= "CBV" or term.right.kind == "variable" or
                    term.right.kind == "abstraction")
         then
            return substitute(term.left.left, term.left.name, term.right), "beta"
        end
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" and strategy ~= "CBN" and strategy ~= "CBV" then
        if strategy == "NORMAL" and eta and eta_redex(term) then
            return term.left.left, "eta"
        end
        local value, kind = one_step(term.left, strategy, eta)
        if value then
            return abstraction(term.name, value), kind
        end
        if eta and eta_redex(term) then
            return term.left.left, "eta"
        end
    end
end
function Workbench:reduce(term, strategy, eta, display)
    local count = 0
    while true do
        local next_term, kind = one_step(term, strategy, eta)
        if not next_term then
            return term, count, true
        end
        if count == self.limit then
            return term, count, false
        end
        term, count = next_term, count + 1
        if display then
            self:emit("step %d (%s): %s", count, kind, print_term(term, true, false))
        end
    end
end
local function size(term)
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return 1
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
        return 1 + size(term.left)
    else
        return 1 + size(term.left) + size(term.right)
    end
end
local function depth(term)
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return 1
    elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
        return 1 + depth(term.left)
    else
        return 1 + math.max(depth(term.left), depth(term.right))
    end
end
local function resolve(value)
    if value.link then
        value.link = resolve(value.link)
        return value.link
    end
    return value
end
local function occurs(variable_type, value)
    value = resolve(value)
    return variable_type == value or
        value.left and (occurs(variable_type, value.left) or occurs(variable_type, value.right))
end
local function unify(a, b)
    a, b = resolve(a), resolve(b)
    if a == b then
        return
    end
    if not a.left then
        if occurs(a, b) then
            error("not typable", 0)
        end
        a.link = b
        return
    end
    if not b.left then
        unify(b, a)
        return
    end
    unify(a.left, b.left)
    unify(a.right, b.right)
end
local function infer_type(term)
    local ok, result =
        pcall(
        function()
            local free, bound = {}, {}
            local function infer(term)
                if term.kind == "variable" then
                    local stack = bound[term.name]
                    if stack and #stack > 0 then
                        return stack[#stack]
                    end
                    free[term.name] = free[term.name] or {}
                    return free[term.name]
                elseif term.kind == "abstraction" then
                    local argument = {}
                    bound[term.name] = bound[term.name] or {}
                    local stack = bound[term.name]
                    stack[#stack + 1] = argument
                    local body = infer(term.left)
                    stack[#stack] = nil
                    return {left = argument, right = body}
                end
                local func, argument, value = infer(term.left), infer(term.right), {}
                unify(func, {left = argument, right = value})
                return value
            end
            local principal, names, counter = infer(term), {}, 0
            local function print_type(value)
                value = resolve(value)
                if not value.left then
                    if not names[value] then
                        names[value] = name_sequence(counter)
                        counter = counter + 1
                    end
                    return names[value]
                end
                local left = print_type(value.left)
                if resolve(value.left).left then
                    left = "(" .. left .. ")"
                end
                return left .. " -> " .. print_type(value.right)
            end
            return print_type(principal)
        end
    )
    if not ok and result ~= "not typable" then
        error(result, 0)
    end
    return ok and result or "not typable"
end
local function church(term)
    if term.kind == "abstraction" and term.left.kind == "abstraction" then
        local outer, inner, body, count = term.name, term.left.name, term.left.left, 0
        while body.kind == "application" and body.left.kind == "variable" and
            body.left.name == outer do
            count = count + 1
            body = body.right
        end
        if body.kind == "variable" and body.name == inner then
            return tostring(count)
        end
        if term.left.left.kind == "variable" and term.left.left.name == outer then
            return "true"
        end
    end
    if
        term.kind == "abstraction" and term.left.kind == "application" and
            term.left.left.kind == "application"
     then
        local body, func = term.left, term.left.left.left
        if
            func.kind == "variable" and func.name == term.name and
                not free_variables(body.left.right)[term.name] and
                not free_variables(body.right)[term.name]
         then
            return "(" .. church(body.left.right) .. ", " .. church(body.right) .. ")"
        end
    end
    return print_term(canonical(term), true, false)
end
local function constant(name)
    return {kind = "constant", name = name}
end
local function abstract_ski(name, term)
    if not free_variables(term)[name] then
        return application(constant("K"), term)
    end
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return constant("I")
    end
    if
        term.right.kind == "variable" and term.right.name == name and
            not free_variables(term.left)[name]
     then
        return term.left
    end
    return application(
        application(constant("S"), abstract_ski(name, term.left)),
        abstract_ski(name, term.right)
    )
end
local function ski(term)
    if term.kind == "variable" then
        return term
    elseif term.kind == "application" then
        return application(ski(term.left), ski(term.right))
    end
    return abstract_ski(term.name, ski(term.left))
end
local function ski_step(term)
    local head, arguments = term, {}
    while head.kind == "application" do
        table.insert(arguments, 1, head.right)
        head = head.left
    end
    local result, used, kind
    if head.kind == "constant" then
        if head.name == "I" and #arguments >= 1 then
            result, used, kind = arguments[1], 1, "I"
        elseif head.name == "K" and #arguments >= 2 then
            result, used, kind = arguments[1], 2, "K"
        elseif head.name == "S" and #arguments >= 3 then
            result, used, kind =
                application(
                    application(arguments[1], arguments[3]),
                    application(arguments[2], arguments[3])
                ),
                3,
                "S"
        end
    end
    if result then
        for i = used + 1, #arguments do
            result = application(result, arguments[i])
        end
        return result, kind
    end
    for i, argument in ipairs(arguments) do
        local next_term, contraction = ski_step(argument)
        if next_term then
            result = head
            for j, item in ipairs(arguments) do
                result = application(result, j == i and next_term or item)
            end
            return result, contraction
        end
    end
end
local function reify(code, environment, inside)
    while code.kind == "index" and code.value >= inside do
        local closure = environment[code.value - inside + 1]
        code, environment, inside = closure.code, closure.environment, 0
    end
    if code.kind == "variable" or code.kind == "index" then
        return code
    end
    if code.kind == "abstraction" then
        return abstraction("", reify(code.left, environment, inside + 1))
    end
    return application(
        reify(code.left, environment, inside),
        reify(code.right, environment, inside)
    )
end
function Workbench:kam(term)
    local code, environment, stack, count = de_bruijn(term), {}, {}, 0
    while true do
        local kind =
            code.kind == "application" and "push" or code.kind == "index" and "access" or
            code.kind == "abstraction" and #stack > 0 and "grab" or
            nil
        if not kind then
            break
        end
        if count == self.limit then
            self:emit("no result within %d transitions", self.limit)
            return
        end
        count = count + 1
        if kind == "push" then
            stack[#stack + 1] = {code = code.right, environment = environment}
            code = code.left
        elseif kind == "grab" then
            local next_environment = {table.remove(stack)}
            for _, closure in ipairs(environment) do
                next_environment[#next_environment + 1] = closure
            end
            environment, code = next_environment, code.left
        else
            local closure = environment[code.value + 1]
            code, environment = closure.code, closure.environment
        end
        if self.steps then
            self:emit(
                "step %d (%s): %s [env %d, stack %d]",
                count,
                kind,
                print_term(code, true, true),
                #environment,
                #stack
            )
        end
    end
    local result = reify(code, environment, 0)
    for i = #stack, 1, -1 do
        result = application(result, reify(stack[i].code, stack[i].environment, 0))
    end
    self:emit(
        "result: %s (transitions: %d)",
        print_term(from_de_bruijn(result), true, false),
        count
    )
end
function Workbench:command(line)
    if line == "" or line:sub(1, 2) == "--" then
        return
    end
    local space = line:find(" ", 1, true)
    local command, arguments, offset = line, "", #line
    if space then
        command, arguments, offset = line:sub(1, space - 1), line:sub(space + 1), space
    end
    if
        not has(
            {
                "let",
                "unlet",
                "macros",
                "steps",
                "eta",
                "limit",
                "expand",
                "subst",
                "reduce",
                "equal",
                "alpha",
                "debruijn",
                "fv",
                "size",
                "depth",
                "type",
                "church",
                "ski",
                "skireduce",
                "kam"
            },
            command
        )
     then
        fail("unknown command %s", command)
    end
    if has({"unlet", "macros", "steps", "eta", "limit"}, command) then
        local words = {}
        for word in arguments:gmatch("%S+") do
            words[#words + 1] = word
        end
        if command == "steps" or command == "eta" then
            if #words ~= 1 or words[1] ~= "on" and words[1] ~= "off" then
                fail("bad argument")
            end
            self[command] = words[1] == "on"
        elseif command == "limit" then
            if #words ~= 1 or #words[1] < 1 or #words[1] > 5 or not words[1]:match("^%d+$") then
                fail("bad argument")
            end
            local value = tonumber(words[1])
            if value < 1 or value > 10000 then
                fail("bad argument")
            end
            self.limit = value
        elseif command == "macros" then
            if #words ~= 0 then
                fail("bad argument")
            end
            local names = {}
            for name in pairs(self.macros) do
                if name ~= "S" and name ~= "K" and name ~= "I" then
                    names[#names + 1] = name
                end
            end
            table.sort(names)
            if #names == 0 then
                self:emit("(none)")
            end
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                self:emit("%s = %s", name, print_term(self.macros[name], true, false))
            end
        else
            if #words ~= 1 or not words[1]:match("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$") then
                fail("bad argument")
            end
            local name = words[1]
            if has(reserved, name) then
                fail("reserved name %s", name)
            end
            if not self.macros[name] then
                fail("unbound macro %s", name)
            end
            local users = {}
            for other, value in pairs(self.macros) do
                if has(references(value), name) then
                    users[#users + 1] = other
                end
            end
            table.sort(users)
            if #users > 0 then
                fail("%s is used by %s", name, users[1])
            end
            self.macros[name] = nil
            self:emit("removed %s", name)
        end
        return
    end
    local parser = setmetatable({tokens = lex(line, arguments, offset), at = 1}, Parser)
    local name, strategy = nil, "NORMAL"
    if command == "let" or command == "subst" then
        name = parser:expect(command == "let" and "macro" or "variable").text
        parser:expect("=")
    end
    if
        command == "reduce" and parser:peek().kind == "macro" and
            has({"NORMAL", "APPLICATIVE", "CBN", "CBV"}, parser:peek().text)
     then
        strategy = parser:peek().text
        parser.at = parser.at + 1
    end
    local first, second = parser:term(), nil
    if command == "subst" or command == "equal" or command == "alpha" then
        parser:expect(";")
        second = parser:term()
    end
    parser:finish()
    if command == "let" then
        if has(reserved, name) then
            fail("reserved name %s", name)
        end
        local seen = {}
        for _, reference in ipairs(references(first)) do
            if self:depends(reference, name, seen) then
                fail("recursive definition of %s", name)
            end
            if not self.macros[reference] then
                fail("unbound macro %s", reference)
            end
        end
        local free = ordered_names(free_variables(first))
        if #free > 0 then
            fail("free variable %s in definition of %s", free[1], name)
        end
        local prefix = self.macros[name] and "redefined" or "defined"
        self.macros[name] = first
        self:emit("%s %s", prefix, name)
        return
    end
    first = self:expand(first)
    if second then
        second = self:expand(second)
    end
    if command == "expand" then
        self:emit("%s", print_term(first, true, false))
    elseif command == "subst" then
        self:emit("%s", print_term(substitute(second, name, first), true, false))
    elseif command == "alpha" then
        self:emit(equivalent(first, second) and "yes" or "no")
    elseif command == "equal" then
        local a, _, ok_a = self:reduce(first, "NORMAL", self.eta, false)
        local b, _, ok_b = self:reduce(second, "NORMAL", self.eta, false)
        if not ok_a or not ok_b then
            self:emit("unknown")
        elseif equivalent(a, b) then
            self:emit("yes")
        else
            self:emit("no")
        end
    elseif command == "debruijn" then
        self:emit("%s", print_term(de_bruijn(first), true, true))
    elseif command == "fv" then
        local names = ordered_names(free_variables(first))
        self:emit("%s", #names == 0 and "(none)" or table.concat(names, " "))
    elseif command == "size" then
        self:emit("%d", size(first))
    elseif command == "depth" then
        self:emit("%d", depth(first))
    elseif command == "type" then
        self:emit("%s", infer_type(first))
    elseif command == "church" then
        local result, _, ok = self:reduce(first, "NORMAL", false, false)
        if ok then
            self:emit("%s", church(canonical(result)))
        else
            self:emit("no normal form within %d steps", self.limit)
        end
    elseif command == "ski" then
        self:emit("%s", print_term(ski(first), true, false))
    elseif command == "skireduce" then
        local value, count = ski(first), 0
        while true do
            local next_term, kind = ski_step(value)
            if not next_term then
                self:emit("result: %s (steps: %d)", print_term(value, true, false), count)
                break
            end
            if count == self.limit then
                self:emit("no normal form within %d steps", self.limit)
                break
            end
            value, count = next_term, count + 1
            if self.steps then
                self:emit("step %d (%s): %s", count, kind, print_term(value, true, false))
            end
        end
    elseif command == "kam" then
        self:kam(first)
    elseif command == "reduce" then
        local result, count, ok = self:reduce(first, strategy, self.eta, self.steps)
        if ok then
            self:emit("result: %s (steps: %d)", print_term(canonical(result), true, false), count)
        else
            self:emit("no normal form within %d steps", self.limit)
        end
    end
end
local workbench = Workbench.new()
for line in io.lines() do
    if line == "quit" then
        break
    end
    local ok, caught =
        pcall(
        function()
            workbench:command(line)
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        if type(caught) ~= "table" or not caught.reason then
            error(caught, 0)
        end
        workbench:emit("error: %s", caught.reason)
    end
end
